blocks.label: Our Studio: paragraph 1

blocks.label: Greeting heading
blocks.text: Hey there! I'm Arielle.

blocks.label: Bio paragraph 1
blocks.text: I'm Arielle, the owner of Rooted and a licensed massage therapist. I've been practicing for nearly five years, and over that time I've learned that good massage has a lot less to do with following a routine and a lot more to do with paying attention to the person in front of you.

blocks.label: Bio paragraph 2
blocks.text: My work ranges from very light lymphatic drainage to deeper, more targeted massage, with a lot of myofascial and nervous-system-focused work mixed in. I don't believe deeper always means better, and I adjust each session based on what your body is actually responding to that day.
blocks.note: was a PLACEHOLDER; now Arielle's real bio

blocks.label: Bio paragraph 3
blocks.text: Caregiving has always come naturally to me, and massage ended up being a way to turn that part of myself into work I genuinely enjoy. More than anything, I want people to feel comfortable, listened to, and like they had someone actually paying attention to them while they were here.

blocks.label: Section 1: title
blocks.text: Your Visit

blocks.label: Q&A: first appointment
blocks.text:
Q: What should I expect at my first appointment?
A: Plan to arrive a few minutes early to go over a short health intake. Arielle will talk through what's going on with your body and what you want out of the session, then tailor the work from there. [PLACEHOLDER: adjust to your actual intake flow.]

blocks.label: Q&A: undressing
blocks.text:
Q: Do I have to undress?
A: Only to your comfort level. You'll always be professionally draped, and great work can be done through clothing if you prefer. Your comfort runs the session.

blocks.label: Q&A: pain
blocks.text:
Q: Should a massage be painful?
A: A massage should never be more intense than you want it to be. Deeper work can involve some “good hurt” as stubborn knots release, but pressure is always adjusted to you; just say the word at any point during your session.

blocks.label: Q&A: talking
blocks.text:
Q: Is there talking (or not talking) during my treatment?
A: Entirely up to you. Many clients prefer quiet; others like to chat. Arielle follows your lead, the only thing she'll always check in about is pressure and comfort.

blocks.label: Q&A: add-ons
blocks.text:
Q: Can I add hot stones, aromatherapy, or cupping?
A: Yes. Add-ons run $5 to $25: aromatherapy ($5), hot stones or a peppermint scalp massage ($10), cupping or fascial scraping ($15), and a lymphatic face massage with our heated infrared Gua Sha tool ($25). You choose them while booking, right after picking your massage. Note that Deep Tissue and Lymphatic Drainage already include their specialty treatments free, and Relax & Reset includes free aromatherapy.

blocks.label: Q&A: new-client special
blocks.text:
Q: Do you have a new-client special?
A: Yes! First-time clients get 15% off a Signature Custom Massage: join our email list to get your discount code. One use per client, Signature massages only.
blocks.note: “join our email list” links to the sign-up form
